model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates responses to a statement regarding the integration of design into the product development process within an organization. The chart is divided into five categories, represented by distinct colors: a blue slice labeled "Изцяло е интегриран" (Completely integrated) with a value of 10, an orange slice labeled "Много добре е интегриран" (Very well integrated) with a value of 24, a green slice labeled "Добре е интегриран" (Well integrated) with a value of 25, a red slice labeled "Слабо е интегриран" (Weakly integrated) with a value of 8, and a purple slice labeled "Не е интегриран такъв подход" (This approach is not integrated) with a value of 20. The chart includes a legend identifying each color and corresponding label, and the values associated with each slice are displayed alongside the labels. The slices appear ordered visually from largest to smallest, with the green slice being the largest and the red slice being the smallest.
